title: Plum Chili Chutney
preamble:
Ingredients:-
800g
fresh plums, de-stoned
125g
soft light brown sugar
1
level teaspoon cumin seeds
1
heaped teaspoons coriander seeds
6
cardamom pods
1
hot chilli, deseeded and chopped very finely
1/2
level teaspoon ground turmeric
30g
fresh root ginger, peeled and grated
1/3
level teaspoon ground cloves
125ml
malt vinegar
2
large cloves garlic, peeled and crushed with 1 rounded teaspoon salt in a pestle and mortar
1
Spanish onions, peeled and finely chopped

125ml
malt vinegar
2
large cloves garlic, peeled and crushed with 1 rounded teaspoon salt in a pestle and mortar
1
Spanish onions, peeled and finely chopped

Method:-
De-stone the plums and chop in a food processor so the skins are too small to notice
Put all the ingredients in a pan and simmer until you have a sticky syrup.
Bottle into sterilised jars.
